The user asks "曼聯的球員名單是什麼？" which means "What is the player list of Manchester United?" They want the roster. We can use the function to retrieve top scorer? But they ask for entire roster. There's no function for roster. So we need to answer manually. Provide current squad list. Use knowledge cutoff 2024-06. Provide list of players as of 2024-06. Let's provide approximate list.

We should mention that the roster may change. Provide list of first-team squad. Provide positions and numbers. Provide some key players. Also note that the list might not be exhaustive. Provide link to official site.
